note: jsonl attempts follow; schema 2 tracks pattern, criteria, evidence, verdict, rollback

opt: rewrite runtime in Rust or Go for speed
crit: must cut >30% of warm p50 duration on at least one official row
base: all python ~55ms of a ~1000ms call: facade 24ms, 60-el AX snap 31-38ms, json 0.1ms
why: dominant cost is cua-driver client process launch, already a signed compiled third-party binary; AX snapshot is AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue round trips that Rust cannot speed up; a new binary is a new TCC subject and loses the com.trycua.driver grant

opt: size or reject a transport change using one benchmark row
crit: attribution must hold per tool across all 4 official rows
base: calculator-8x8: 2 driver calls, 3-7% of wall, so transport looked worthless
after: whatsapp-new-chat: 2 press_key = 24.2s driver in a 16.0s row; CLI 5605-9689ms vs socket 0-83ms
why: calculator makes only cheap driver calls; generalizing from it wrongly rejected the highest-value optimization in the plugin

opt: size the cua-driver CLI tax from one cheap tool
crit: primitive latency must predict real per-tool cost within 2x
base: get_cursor_position CLI 169.8ms implied a uniform ~170ms CLI tax
after: press_key CLI 5605-9689ms; real spread is 170ms to 9.7s by tool
why: CLI overhead is tool-dependent, so a single cheap primitive under-sizes the worst paths by ~50x
